jobs.occupation: Order picker in day shift - open to English speakers!
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

Job Description

In this hands-on position with the European Customer Analytical Services - Technology Centre of Excellence, you will perform root cause investigations into metallurgical failures and assess corrosion mechanisms. Serving clients throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, you will analyze samples from hydrocarbon process and water treatment operations-such as petroleum refineries, cooling towers, heat exchangers, and boilers. Your expertise in metallurgy and failure analysis will directly drive critical materials and reliability decisions across water and hydrocarbon process systems.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Conduct comprehensive metallurgical failure analyses and corrosion mechanism assessments, gathering necessary process information and determining required analytical approaches to determine root causes of failures in industrial water and hydrocarbon process systems

• 
Act as the technical go-to for metallurgical evaluations and materials selection, providing consulting support across the organization

• 
Operate the Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM-EDXA) and other analytical instrumentation to support metallurgical examinations

• 
Execute failure analysis investigations on membrane systems (reverse osmosis, ultra-/nanfiltration membranes, flat sheet and spiral wound, as well as hollow fibre configurations), delivering clear findings and recommendations

• 
Collaborate with other laboratory departments (organic analyses, microbiological examinations, etc.) to gather comprehensive analytical data

• 
Prepare detailed, professional analytical reports and provide high-level technical input to Technology and Commercial teams

• 
Deliver work on schedule in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining compliance with all EHS policies and procedures

• 
Take ownership of customer application and R&D projects on membrane systems, including planning, execution, and reporting

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment.

• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.
